question: The Quit India Movement started in the year:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1942.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On **8 August 1942** at the All-India Congress Committee session in Bombay, **Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi** start the** 'Quit India' movement. **
 
• A while later, **Gandhi, Nehru, and many other leaders** of the Indian National Congress were **arrested by the British Government.**
 
• The Quit India Movement was announced by **the Indian National Congress** after the failure of the **Cripps Mission.**
 
• The movement began in a speech in Bombay, where Mahatma Gandhi asked Indians to** Do or Die.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Khilafat movement (1919-1924) was **a trouble by Indian Muslims allied with Indian nationalism in the years following World War I**.
 
• Dandi March was **a 24-day non-violent march conduct by Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• **Champaran** has been the** starting point of India's independence movement** began by Gandhi.
